transcript: Speaker A: Yaar Priya tumhara promotion ho gaya na. [Hey Priya, you got promoted, right?] Speaker B: Arey haan, manager ke saath uski English conversation suni hai. Promotion was bound to happen.] Speaker A: Waise Priya, kya sach mein teri English itni achhi hai? Aur agar koi grammar mistake ho na, toh AI teachers turant correct kar dete the. [Yes, on this app I practiced real English conversations with AI teachers. And if there was any grammar mistake, the AI teachers would correct it immediately.] Speaker B: Lekin English seekhne mein toh kaafi time lagta hai na? [But learning English takes a lot of time, right?] Speaker C: Bilkul nahi. Roz 10 se 15 minutes is app pe practice karo aur 15 se 20 dinon mein ekdum fluent English bolna seekh jaoge. [Not at all. Practice 10 to 15 minutes daily on this app and in 15 to 20 days you will learn to speak fluent English.] Speaker A: Par kahan yaar, hamari salary aapki tarah thodi na hai ki app use kar payen. [But where, friend, our salary is not like yours that we can afford to use the app.] Speaker C: Sirf ₹2 mein 7 din ka trial le sakte ho. [You can get a 7-day trial for just ₹2.] Speaker B: Arey wah, ab next promotion mera. [Oh wow, now the next promotion is mine.] Speaker A: Nahi, nahi mera. [No, no, mine.] Speaker C: Haan, toh uske liye pehle SpeakX app download karo. [Yes, so for that, first download the SpeakX app.]
